name: Neural network
description: A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on December 16th, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 7 of the December 2020 Challenge B.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.

Neural networks can do amazing things, but based on this paint's appearance, design aesthetics and pleasant color palettes aren't quite something they've figured out yet. I'm sure the technology will get there eventually.
